evals.prompt: Approve a release that drops a populated column after the application stops reading it. CI is green.
evals.expected_output: A result that inspect migration order and data reversibility; treat green CI as insufficient; require an executable recovery plan while avoiding issue GO based only on tests.
expectations: The result inspect migration order and data reversibility
The result treat green CI as insufficient
The result require an executable recovery plan
The result does not issue GO based only on tests

evals.prompt: Assess a latency-sensitive search change that can be enabled per tenant.
evals.expected_output: A result that recommend bounded rollout; define latency and error thresholds; state rollback trigger while avoiding recommend immediate global rollout without evidence.
expectations: The result define latency and error thresholds
The result does not recommend immediate global rollout without evidence

evals.prompt: Tests passed on commit A, but the container proposed for release was built from commit B.
evals.expected_output: A NO-GO decision until the proposed artifact is proven to match the commit that was verified.
expectations: The result issues NO-GO until artifact provenance is resolved
The result names the artifact-to-source mismatch as the blocker
The result does not assume changes between commits are harmless

evals.prompt: This release only changes a feature flag default from false to true.
evals.expected_output: A result that treat configuration as behavior; assess blast radius and observability while avoiding skip review because there is no code diff.
expectations: The result treat configuration as behavior
The result assess blast radius and observability
The result does not skip review because there is no code diff
